pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our team
Anders Engelbrecht Kristensen
Senior Healthcare Consultant
Anders Engelbrecht Kristensen holds an MSc in Medical Market Access and a BSc in Medicine with Industrial Specialization. Anders has worked with different external partners within the pharmaceutical & Medico industry during his studies. The projects included health economic modelling, market access strategies, and budget impact modeling. Prior to joining Zealth, Anders worked as an Associate Health Economist at Ambu A/S with focus on internal strategic consulting regarding price setting of devices and health economic expertise. Anders’ work at Zealth primarily focuses on Nordic market access projects and medical affairs in the Nordic countries.
André Rodriguez
Healthcare consultant
André Rodriguez is currently finalizing his MSc in Medical Market Access and holds a BSc in Medicine with Industrial Specialization. During his studies, André has collaborated with different external partners within the pharmaceutical and MedTech industry as well as the Danish healthcare system. The projects included health economic and budget impact modelling, market access strategies and key opinion leader interviews. Prior to joining Zealth, André worked as a Junior Researcher at a Nordic Institute of Health Economics with focus on delivering evidence-based analyses and strategic insights in health economics, market access, and real-world evidence. André’s work at Zealth focuses on Nordic and national customer projects, data collection, and various ad hoc tasks.
Andreas Pousette
Healthcare Manager
Andreas Pousette holds an MSc in Public Health with a specialization in Health Economics from Umeå University. Andreas has over four years of experience working as a Health Economist at the Dental and Pharmaceutical Benefits Agency (TLV). There, he was involved in numerous assessments of new medicines across various therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, oncology, metabolic disorders, and rare genetic disorders. Prior to joining Zealth, Andreas worked as a Research Manager at the Swedish Institute for Health Economics, where he was involved in market access projects in the Nordic countries and in evaluating cancer policies within the European Union. He possesses in-depth knowledge of the Swedish market, ranging from HTA submissions to engaging with decision-makers at both national and regional levels.
Anna Sofie Jarlkvist
Senior Healthcare Consultant
Anna Sofie holds an MSc in Medical Market Access and a BSc in Medicine with Industrial Specialization. Anna Sofie has worked with different external partners within the pharmaceutical industry and the public healthcare system during her studies. The projects included health economic modelling, market access strategies and stakeholder interviews. Prior to joining Zealth, Anna Sofie worked as a Covid-19 Test Ambassador with the Danish Patient Safety Authority and was also a member of the Covid-19 task force at the North Denmark Region. Anna Sofie’s work at Zealth primarily focuses on Nordic market access projects and medical affairs in the Nordic countries.
Daniel Brath
Senior Director Zealth
Daniel Brath is leading Zealth day to day operations. He has 15 years of experience from Novo Nordisk and AstraZeneca, covering cardiometabolic diseases, oncology, respiratory and various rare disease. He has worked at Global, regional and affiliate level in Denmark, Europe and Asia. He brings several years of experience within Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Public Affairs and Sales.
James Baker Knight
Senior Manager
James holds a PGCert in Health Economics and a BSc in Mathematics. James previously worked as a Global HEOR Lead and Global Pricing Lead at Novo Nordisk, developing strategies primarily across diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular disease. Prior to this, he worked at DRG Abacus as a Health Economics Consultant, being involved in a wide range of market access activities.
Jeppe Kassow Rasmussen
Senior Healthcare Consultant
Jeppe Kassow Rasmussen holds an MSc in Medical Market Access and a BSc in Medicine with Industrial Specialization. Jeppe previously worked as a Health Economic Consultant at the Danish Medicines Council, handling expert committee engagement, health economic modelling and market access strategies in a national perspective. He has been involved in numerous assessments across different disease areas, ranging from chronic diseases to urgent types of cancer, while taking part in the development of the methodology and processes of the evaluation of new pharmaceuticals.
Jesper Zacho
CEO
Jesper is the owner and founder of Zealth and ijovi. He has 20+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and consulting. Prior, he was Eli Lilly’s Country Lead for Denmark and Scandinavian Business Unit Director for oncology. He was also a member of Eli Lilly’s international management team for oncology. As Managing Director for Zealth & ijovi, his focus is on strategic support within brand
